# Freelankarx

> Premium digital execution brand helping ambitious businesses create websites, Shopify stores, AI automation, business automation, task bots, email marketing, social media marketing, SEO, resume writing, LinkedIn optimization, UI/UX design, and reputation management.

## About

Freelankarx is a one-person premium digital studio led by Olamilekan Muraina, based in Lagos, Nigeria, serving clients in 15+ countries worldwide.

Founded on the philosophy that businesses deserve digital experiences that don't just look beautiful but create real growth, trust, and transformation.

## Services

- Web Development (custom websites, web applications)
- Shopify Development (custom stores, conversion optimization)
- Ecommerce Development (WooCommerce, headless commerce, custom builds)
- AI Automation (chatbots, workflow automation, AI agents)
- Business Automation (Zapier, Make, custom integrations)
- Task Bot Development (Telegram bots, Discord bots, Slack bots, scrapers)
- Email Marketing (Klaviyo, Mailchimp, ConvertKit, automations)
- Social Media Marketing (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook)
- Shopify SEO (technical SEO, content optimization, link building)
- Conversion Rate Optimization (A/B testing, funnel optimization)
- Resume Writing (executive resumes, ATS optimization)
- LinkedIn Optimization (profile overhaul, content strategy)
- Online Reputation Management (reviews, monitoring, crisis management)
- UI/UX Design (user research, wireframing, prototypes)
- Maintenance & Support (updates, security, backups, monitoring)

## Target Audience

- Small to medium business owners
- Ecommerce brands
- Startups and entrepreneurs
- Agencies and consultants
- Personal brands and professionals
- Anyone seeking premium digital services
